name: Multi-resolution LOD Volume Rendering with Temporal Coherence
aliases: LOD Volume Rendering with Temporal Coherence
definition: A volume rendering technique that assigns different resolution levels to subvolumes based on their importance (projection area, gaze distance) to optimize performance while maintaining visual quality, using temporal coherence to prevent flickering during view changes.
summary: Multi-resolution LOD Volume Rendering with Temporal Coherence optimizes performance by assigning resolution levels to subvolumes based on visual importance while preventing flickering through constrained, frame-to-frame transitions.
